title: Sorting The Array Speeds Up The Loop That Ignores It
summary: Write the branch condition yourself and watch a predictor try to guess it. The same loop over the same numbers costs far more when they arrive shuffled, because every wrong guess throws the pipeline away.

sources.title: Smith, A Study of Branch Prediction Strategies, ISCA 1981 (the two-bit saturating counter)
Yeh and Patt, Two-Level Adaptive Training Branch Prediction, MICRO 1991
Hennessy and Patterson, Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach, chapter on control hazards and branch prediction
